title: anacyclus pyrethrum
intro: Anacyclus pyrethrum, commonly known as Dalmatian chamomile or pyrethrum, is a perennial plant species belonging to the daisy family. It is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, making it effective in soothing digestive issues, reducing anxiety, and promoting relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Anacyclus pyrethrum are attributed to its ability to calm the nervous system, ease pain, and act as an antispasmodic. The bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
